comment: Hard grader, won't see your works back ever. a lot of busy work. However, she is nice person and down to earth professor, tries to make this class interesting with the field trips and guest speakers. Also you get extra credit for perfect attendance.

Disregard the previous post. Sure there's alot of assignments, but they are easy.  If you're a marketing major, take Babb, and work your ass off.  If not, take her and save yourself the stress.  Down to earth prof, was pregnant this semester which is why she was so late with grades.  I got an A by doing all the busy work on time. Lots of EC too.

There will be so many little and annoying assignments you won?t believe it. Loves assignments, but takes ages to grade them:  you will never see them back,  all your feedback will be a grade on Blackboard. If you actually want to improve you?ll have to set-up an appointment and see her in her office. Do yourself a favor and take Babb instead.
